prompt.on: Long-video title (experiment dd-long-title-3d, on): name the event as people search it first (the 23 Nov rule), then say it is rebuilt in 3D, then the curiosity, e.g. 'The Colgan Air Crash, Rebuilt in 3D: The Stall Warning Nobody Called'. Only when the video's reconstruction is drawn in the 3D kit; a long video without 3D beats writes the off title.
prompt.off: Long-video title (experiment dd-long-title-3d, off): the champion: the event's searched name, then the curiosity ('The Colgan Air Crash: The Stall Warning That Rewrote Pilot Rules'); never say '3D' in the title.

experiments.description: Disaster Desk long videos: 'Rebuilt in 3D' after the event's name in the title, against the name-then-curiosity title (judged on views in 7 days)
